_why_committed_first: The blinding is a SEQUENCE, not an intention. This draw is committed before any re-derived name exists, so the git history evidences that the sample was fixed before the answers -- the same discipline as the art calls, and for the same reason: a selection chosen after seeing results is not a sample.
_what_is_withheld: name. It is the field all three known errors live in, and it is the answer.
_this_estimate_is_a_floor: The researcher assembled most of this set. Where a recalled memory is of the ORIGINAL MISTAKE, the re-derivation reproduces it and the comparison agrees -- so the bias is not even noise, it is blind to exactly the error class the known errors belong to. A fresh researcher is the clean instrument; this one bounds e from below.
_n_is_a_screen_not_a_certification: 30 identities with zero disagreements bounds e at 9.5%. ADR-0015 needs e < 2%, which takes 149. If e were 10% this sample misses it 5% of the time, so it is a cheap screen for a gross problem and licenses nothing beyond moving on to a real sample.
